component_mappings.verification_focus: Check if new state properties in TrackState or PlayerState are reflected in data flows and replacement tokens.
Ensure all action names, UUIDs, dial behaviors, and visual indicators are described accurately.
Confirm HTTP endpoints (/overlay, /api/current), query parameters, and chatbot responses are up to date.
Verify port binding (39865), protocol messages, and version mismatch event definitions.
Check permissions, background service worker, and context isolation boundaries (MAIN vs ISOLATED).
Verify that all root npm run scripts are listed in the developer command tables.
